overrideHooks.basis: GuiGraphics.renderDeferredElements() became extractDeferredElements(mouseX, mouseY, partialTick) (same body; 1.21.11 read the mouse position from its fields, 26.1 keeps those fields and also draws the IME pre-edit overlay with the partial tick)

overrideRenames.basis: GuiGraphics.renderComponentHoverEffect lives on as GuiGraphicsExtractor.componentHoverEffect, same descriptor and body; vanilla calls it with invokevirtual and the layer's access widener makes it extendable, so the renamed override is what 26.1 calls. Vanilla never passes a null style (both releases test first); the mod's own calls go through CbWallGui, which keeps 1.21.11's null test

adapterHooks.basis: 1.21.11 BlockStateModel.particleIcon() became particleMaterial() (sprite + forceTranslucent, false for what 1.21.11 could express); materialFlags() is new and computed from the quads of the parts the model collects (seed 42, as 1.21.11 ModelBlockRenderer.renderModel)
1.21.11 BlockModelPart.particleIcon() became particleMaterial(); materialFlags() is new: the OR of the quads flags, as 26.1 QuadCollection computes it

a 1.21.11 mod class implementing BlockAndTintGetter itself (getShade + getBlockTint) is a 26.1 client BlockAndTintGetter: its getBlockTint implements 26.1s, cardinalLighting() is its shaded value per face (26.1 lights unshaded quads with up(), which equals 1.21.11s unshaded shade in vanilla)

a 1.21.11 model sprite getter answers 26.1 MaterialBaker: the material id in 1.21.11 virtual model atlas BLOCK_OR_ITEM (what every 1.21.11 model texture carried), its sprite with the material forceTranslucent flag
a 1.21.11 getter overriding the default resolveSlot keeps answering it in 26.1
